description: This file defines the SugarFeed class, which manages the social feed functionalities within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for activating/deactivating modules, fetching feed files, pushing feed entries, handling link types, and rendering feed data, as well as utility functions related to time lapse calculation and message parsing.

classes.name: SugarFeed
classes.description: Class managing the social feed functionalities in SuiteCRM, including module activation, feed entry creation, and rendering.

methods.name: activateModuleFeed
methods.description: Activates the feed for a specified module by requiring feed files and updating settings.

methods.name: disableModuleFeed
methods.description: Deactivates the feed for a specified module by requiring feed files and updating settings.

methods.name: flushBackendCache
methods.description: Clears cached feed module and link type data, including cache files.

methods.name: getModuleFeedFiles
methods.description: Returns a list of feed files for a given module, including overriding logic.

methods.name: getActiveFeedModules
methods.description: Retrieves the list of active feed modules, utilizing cache and settings.

methods.name: getAllFeedModules
methods.description: Scans all modules and returns all modules with feed files, including default 'UserFeed'.

methods.name: pushFeed2
methods.description: Wrapper method to push a feed entry using the associated bean.

methods.name: pushFeed
methods.description: Creates and saves a new feed record with provided text, module info, and optional link data.

methods.name: getLinkTypes
methods.description: Retrieves link handler types for feeds, utilizing cache and scanning directories.

methods.name: getLinkClass
methods.description: Loads and returns an instance of the specified link handler class.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares and returns data for rendering the list view, including formatting and delete links.

methods.name: fetchReplies
methods.description: Fetches reply comments for a given feed item and generates HTML for display.

methods.name: getTimeLapse
methods.description: Calculates and returns a human-readable relative time difference between now and a given start date.

methods.name: parseMessage
methods.description: Parses message text, converting URLs into clickable links.
